name: dispatch
description: | Use when a task file exists in .hyperflow/tasks/ and workers need dispatching. Fans out parallel workers under per-batch Reviewers, runs a final integration review, and commits per sub-task. Endpoint of the auto-chain — no auto-deploy. Trigger with /hyperflow:dispatch, "run the plan", "execute the task", "build it", "run the batches".
author: jeremylongshore
summary_zh: 用于按任务文件分批调度并行执行，自动完成子任务提交、批次审查和最终集成检查，适合落地既定开发计划。
